name: whole-word
use: The match-whole-word toggle in find and replace (Cursor, VS Code), beside case-sensitive and regex, which Area has.

name: text-search
use: Search inside contents rather than titles: search in files, full-text search results.

name: list-filter
use: The filter control on table, list and board views (Notion, Linear); Area's funnel reads as a stronger filter action.

name: git-graph
use: The commit graph in source control (Cursor's Source Control Graph).

name: git-branch-plus
use: Create branch, beside git-branch and git-fork.

name: git-pull-request-create
use: Create pull request; Area has the open, closed and draft states.

name: diff
use: Compare changes and open a diff (review, checkpoints); file-diff covers a single file only.

name: repository
use: A code repository (GitHub's book with a bookmark).

name: issue
use: An open issue (GitHub, Linear): a ring with a centre dot. Area's circle-dot-dashed is a dashed status.

name: folder-git
use: A folder under version control, a cloned workspace.

name: folder-code
use: A code project folder (Open project, recent workspaces).

name: folder-tree
use: The file explorer tree; list-tree is a nested list, not files.

name: folder-input
use: Move to a folder (Notion's Move to, file managers).

name: file-json
use: JSON and config files in file lists and attachments.

name: file-warning
use: A file with problems (Problems panel, failed lint).

name: square-terminal
use: The terminal panel or console tab; terminal alone reads as a prompt, not a window.

name: logs
use: Output and log panels, run and build logs.

name: pipeline
use: CI/CD pipelines and workflow runs.

name: container
use: Containers and deploy targets (Docker, cloud agents' environments).

name: server-cog
use: Server and MCP server settings.

name: database-search
use: Query a database, search indexed data (codebase indexing).

name: database-zap
use: Cache and fast data (cached results, prompt caching).

name: cloud-sync
use: Settings sync and cloud sync status; Area has sync and cloud-check.

name: api
use: API connections, connected integrations and MCP servers.

name: memory
use: Memory and RAM usage (resource monitors, model hardware).

name: brain-circuit
use: An AI model in a model picker; brain stays for thinking and memory.

name: toolbox
use: An agent's tools and MCP tools as a set; wrench and hammer are single tools.

name: telescope
use: Deep research and long exploration modes in AI products.

name: scan-text
use: Extract text from an image or document (OCR, vision).

name: siren
use: Incidents, on-call and urgent alerts.

name: square-mouse-pointer
use: Select an element on a page (Cursor's browser, DevTools inspect).

name: text-select
use: Select all, a text selection, quote a selection into chat.

name: table-of-contents
use: Notion's table of contents block and a document outline.

name: layout-template
use: Templates (Notion, Figma, page builders).

name: timeline
use: Notion's timeline view and VS Code's Timeline (file history).

name: milestone
use: Roadmaps and milestones in project tools.

name: monitor-cog
use: The System theme option and display settings.

name: stamp
use: Approvals, sign-off and stamped templates.

name: component
use: Figma's component and component set in the layers panel and inspector.

name: slice
use: Figma's slice tool for export regions.

name: blend
use: Layer blend mode in the inspector.

name: swatch-book
use: Color styles and swatch libraries.

name: line-style
use: Stroke style (solid, dashed, dotted) in the stroke settings.
